tasks.task: Take in a new client before touching the account

items.when: In the first talk with a new client, to collect the facts every later choice depends on
When price and margin are known, to set the return and cost per sale the ads must beat

tasks.task: Audit a Meta ad account

items.when: When you have the exports and want the account read the way a senior buyer would
When you want thirty weighted checks across tracking, creative, structure and audiences
When there are too many campaigns, to call each one keep or cut with its set-up errors
When Meta's reported return looks too good against what the store banked

tasks.task: Check the pixel and Conversions API signal

items.when: Before any spend decision, to check Meta gets clean and complete conversion data
When events are missing or match quality is low and you need step-by-step fixes
When choosing a server route, to check it and rule out double counting
Each month, to catch broken tracking before it skews the results read

tasks.task: Plan a month of Meta ads from the margin

items.when: When you have spend, results and reviews and need an ad quota, budget split and test rules
When the campaign and ad set layout must be set with budgets and targets
When the budget is proposed, to test it against the break-even return

tasks.task: Launch a campaign or rebuild a messy account

items.when: For a new campaign, product, offer or market, or when rebuilding a messy account
When the launch changes a live account and needs the client's yes
When old campaigns must be kept or cut and a simpler layout built
When new concepts need a test campaign with ad pack names and scale rules
When an ad is finished, to check and fix it until it is ready to run

tasks.task: Write creative briefs from winners and customer words

items.when: When the account needs new concepts and you have past results plus real customer language
Before briefing, to split each winner into message and look and find what to swap
When you need concepts in seven different groups with the best eight ranked
When each brief must fit a funnel stage and be ready for production
When creative comes back, to check it against the brief and the product facts
When every concept is a feature list and none has a true tension in it

tasks.task: Plan and read creative tests

items.when: When new concepts need a fair test and winners must be chosen on evidence
When the ads are all one type, to sort them, spot gaps and get three test plans
When tests run in sprints and each should carry forward what the last one showed
When results are in by ad set, to call keep, leave or replace and spot false winners
When you want the hit rate and which concepts clear the profit line

tasks.task: Write an ad copy set

items.when: When the offer and buyer are known and you need primary text, hooks and scripts to test
When the opening is flat, to get hooks by five tactics ranked by buyer fit and proof
When one idea works, to get ten or more different angles with a test order
Before upload, to score the ad against Meta's rules and get a compliant rewrite
When the copy makes a big promise and the proof under it is thin

tasks.task: Plan static image ads

items.when: When you want to choose from twelve static patterns by buyer stage and proof
When you have brand facts, customer evidence and product photos and need varied concepts
When review lines should become quote cards with the words kept exact
When an ad is drafted, to score it against its page and get fixes

tasks.task: Script video and creator ads

items.when: When you have the buyer and proof and want four script types, each with its opening
When the script should be built from real customer quotes with a source for every line
When customers or creators will film, to plan the brief and how their posts are reused
When the script is drafted, to find each weak line and get a fix

tasks.task: Plan retargeting for visitors who did not buy

items.when: When you have reviews and store results and want one ad per objection in sequence
When you know why visitors leave and need the ads ordered, ending with a cross-sell
When there are several exit reasons, to get one ad for each and a test order

tasks.task: Set up catalogue and sales campaigns for a store

items.when: When the store's products and margins must shape the campaign and ad set layout
Before choosing what to push, to grade each product and set its ad target

tasks.task: Plan a lead campaign and the hand-off

items.when: When leads are cheap but poor, to get raise-or-cut fixes and a better form
When you must decide which question to add next to filter time-wasters
When leads go cold because nobody owns the first call
When new leads wait, to qualify each and draft the first reply the owner sends
When you need cost per booked job, not cost per form fill

tasks.task: Run the weekly optimisation routine

items.when: Once a week on the same day, so the weekend is in the data
With the latest export, to get a short note the owner can act on in five minutes
When each ad needs marking keep, watch, refresh or pause with the proof
When you want a true-return check and a scale-or-hold call on the week
When the week's changes need the client's yes before you make them

tasks.task: Spot creative fatigue and refresh winners

items.when: Twice a week, to catch tired ads early and get a brief for each replacement
When a winner is fading, to find the cause and get ranked revival moves
When a winner should be extended to other customer groups in the same voice
When the live ads feel alike, to group them by idea and score the sameness

tasks.task: Decide when and how to scale spend

items.when: When winners, margins and cash are known and you need a spend ladder
When several budget moves are possible, to compare three plans and their risks
Before raising spend, to test the reported return against real sales

tasks.task: Diagnose delivery problems and result drops

items.when: When ads will not spend or leave learning, to find the failing step and what to change
When results changed, to test six possible causes and say how sure you are

tasks.task: Check policy and Special Ad Categories

items.when: Before launching in a sensitive area, or after an ad is rejected
When one ad needs each problem named with its fix and a rewrite
When a rejected ad must be fixed and re-checked until it passes

tasks.task: Plan a lift test on Meta

items.when: When the owner asks if Meta ads really drive sales, or before a big budget move
Every three months, and after a big change in strategy, site or tracking
When you know spend and regions and need a lift test sized to them
When the test has ended, to decide whether to trust it and state the lift as a range
When the account takes credit for buyers who would have come anyway

tasks.task: Match the landing page to the ad

items.when: When the ad is set and the page must pick up exactly where it left off
When you want page copy with three design directions and a scored review
When ad and page both exist, to score the match and rank the mismatches

tasks.task: Study rivals in the Ad Library

items.when: When you need a rival's live ads gathered from the public library
When pasted ads should be sorted into types with what to study in each
When you want the gaps rivals leave turned into briefs

tasks.task: Report results and true return to the owner

items.when: When you have two periods of totals and need the one-line answer and three actions
When Meta, Google and GA4 disagree and the report must say why
When dated results and targets are to hand, to rank findings and name evidence gaps
Before sending, to read the report as the owner would and list what is unclear

tasks.task: Test offers without wrecking the margin

items.when: When there are several offers and buyer types, to set separate tests and a read-out rule
Before an offer runs, to find the deepest discount the margin allows

always.when: Before any ad or report states a number, a result or a customer claim, to check it traces

helpers.when: When the account needs a full concept pipeline, not a handful of briefs
When scripts must become finished video ads in every placement size
When image ads must be designed, not only planned
When the lift test or the gap between platform and store numbers needs deeper work
When the pixel, catalogue feed or checkout events must be fixed inside the store
When the landing page needs writing in full

gaps: No library item sets up a Meta catalogue: feed health, product sets and catalogue or Advantage+ ads
No library item covers Advantage+ sales campaign settings such as the existing customer cap and audience controls
No library item builds a Meta lead form with filtering questions and higher-intent settings
No library item writes first messages for new leads or reviews cost per booked job for a local firm
No library item covers Special Ad Categories for housing, credit and jobs; only the kit prompt does
No library item sets up a Meta Conversion Lift study or an A/B test in Experiments
No library item plans click-to-message ads for WhatsApp or Messenger
No library item plans audiences: exclusions, lookalikes against broad, and radius targeting for a local firm
No library item handles ad comments: what to hide, what to answer and how
No library item writes a client change request or sets a naming convention for campaigns and ads; only the kit covers the first
